subject: Quick thought on Sour Duck's website + a live mockup
body: Hi Sour Duck Team, I am a huge fan of your scratch-made baking using Barton Springs Mill flour and those smoked meats coming straight out of the 1,000-gallon pit smoker. While grabbing lunch and checking your menu on my phone in the beer garden, I noticed that the mobile typography contrast could be improved for easy outdoor viewing, and direct social media icons in the footer would make it simpler for locals to stay connected. I put together a quick, modern prototype for Sour Duck Market with cleaner menu tabs and optimized typography so it is easier to browse on mobile. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b594e1e61e01-0x70d7243021911e1-99epsxjb8.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I am happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Optimized menu typography contrast for outdoor smartphone viewing
Added direct social media icon links to the footer
